thesis.primaryProblem: Practical self-improvement advice is often fragmented into shallow tips with unclear evidence, fit, limitations and stopping conditions.
thesis.primaryAudience: People looking for one evidence-aware practical routine they can inspect before using.
thesis.usefulOutcome: Find one bounded protocol for a real-life problem, understand why it may fit, inspect its evidence and limits, and take one useful next move.
thesis.distinctEvidence: Reviewed protocol records, explicit evidence states, source provenance, stable identities, versioned datasets and reproducible retrieval artifacts.
thesis.primaryAction: Choose one relevant protocol and inspect its evidence and stop conditions.

in: bounded routines for focus, stress, memory, sleep, habits, learning and movement
adjacent: research notes and evidence review infrastructure
read-only API, retrieval and agent integration surfaces
the legacy LifeOS organizer as an optional application layer
out: a feature race for an all-purpose personal organizer
search ranking or AI citation guarantees

problemLanes.label: Find
problemLanes.job: Move from a messy everyday problem to one relevant bounded protocol.
problemLanes.audience: A person who knows the situation they want to improve but not which routine fits.
problemLanes.problem: Large libraries and generic advice make it hard to choose one useful next move.
problemLanes.desiredOutcome: Reach a small set of relevant protocols without browsing unrelated knowledge.
problemLanes.primaryAction: Use the problem, topic or protocol finder.

problemLanes.label: Evaluate
problemLanes.job: Understand why a protocol may fit and where its evidence or applicability stops.
problemLanes.audience: A reader deciding whether a practical routine is credible and appropriate for the situation.
problemLanes.problem: Practical advice is easy to overstate when sources, evidence state and limitations are detached from the action.
problemLanes.desiredOutcome: See evidence state, sources, limitations and stop conditions before treating a protocol as trusted guidance.
problemLanes.primaryAction: Inspect the protocol evidence and methodology.

problemLanes.label: Apply
problemLanes.job: Turn the selected protocol into one bounded action while preserving context.
problemLanes.audience: A person ready to try a low-risk practical routine.
problemLanes.problem: Useful knowledge often remains descriptive instead of becoming a small executable next step.
problemLanes.desiredOutcome: Complete one practical next move without converting the site into an unbounded coaching or treatment system.

visualPrinciples: Keep the bright friendly Brali identity while making the useful next move visually dominant.
Show evidence and limitations as part of the content rather than as decorative trust badges.
Reveal technical data and agent surfaces after the human problem and protocol path is clear.
Prefer problem-first entry points over exposing the size of the knowledge system.

notes: Research, API, AI and ontology surfaces support the practical-protocol product; they are not separate homepage product territories.
The Core Web Vitals values are budgets. Field measurements remain separate evidence and must not be fabricated by the focus audit.
A Site Focus pass does not imply ranking, indexing, citation or protocol efficacy.
